title: Road corridors in Northern Ireland: motorways and primary roads (OpenStreetMap)
coverage: Northern Ireland: OpenStreetMap motorways ('strategic') and primary roads ('primary'); secondary roads left out. Community-mapped, not official data; classes follow OpenStreetMap, not GB's trunk and primary-route designations

retrieval.method: Read offline from the shapefile John provided (OpenStreetMap roads, exported from ArcGIS Pro)
retrieval.notes: Lines merged by road number and class, simplified at 60 m in Irish Transverse Mercator (EPSG:2157), WGS84 to 5 decimals. Lines show road corridors, not freight flows. Published under the ODbL, as a database derived from OpenStreetMap.
